items.title: Awesome Wardley Maps
items.content_text:
### Mapping

*   [Map](https://map.tranquil.systems) - Native macOS app to build wardley maps using its own `wmap` syntax (Apple Silicon only). GPLv3. It includes a QuickLook plugin to preview `wmap` files as images.
items.content_html:

items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Syntax / Diagnostics

*   [fei6409/log-highlight.nvim (⭐101)](https://github.com/fei6409/log-highlight.nvim) - Generic log syntax highlighting and log filetype management support.

### Utility / Diagnostics

*   [mahyarmirrashed/famous-quotes.nvim (⭐1)](https://github.com/mahyarmirrashed/famous-quotes.nvim) - Get famous quotes from history to display on startup.
*   [johannww/tts.nvim (⭐9)](https://github.com/johannww/tts.nvim) - Text to speech tool based on the Microsoft Edge online services.
